amanda: Quick sync  I'm opening a tiny docs PR to add a compact section about prefetch + quant profiles in the Optimize migration guide. It will include two SDK snippets, a short decision table, and links to an example smoke test.

ryan: Can you paste the snippets inline so reviewers can copy? Also add console steps for toggling prefetch.

amanda: Yep. Planned JS snippet (copyable):

```js
// short-prefix preset (safe with q4_fast)
await client.optimize.update({
  model: 'redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching: { strategy: 'microbatch', maxBatchMs: 12 },
  cache: { prefetch: { enabled: false } }
});
```

and Python equivalent:

```py
# short-prefix preset (safe with q4_fast)
client.optimize.update(
  model='redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching={'strategy': 'microbatch', 'max_batch_ms': 12},
  cache={'prefetch': {'enabled': False}}
)
```

vikram: Add a one-sentence explanation: why false for q4_fast (first-token tail spikes due to grouped-attention KV warmup). Keep tone neutral.

amanda: Will do. Also adding a tiny table with three rows: short-prefix / long-stream / embeddings and recommended preset.

ryan: Please include the console UI path and screenshots? If not screenshots, at least the UI labels so support can point customers.

amanda: I'll add Console > Optimize > Pipeline > Caching > Prefetch (toggle) as the path. No screenshots in the first PR to keep it light.

vikram: Tests: create `examples/optimize/prefetch-smoke` that runs with `--profile=q4_fast` and uploads a CSV check. CI should assert p95_first_token < 150ms after warmup for the short-prefix preset.

amanda: I'll add that and attach job 2210 artifacts. PR branch `docs/opt-prefetch-3076543210`. Labels: `docs:optimize`, `needs-ml-review`, `examples`.

docbot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/3301 by amanda  labels: docs:optimize, needs-ml-review, examples. CI: docs-lint passed.

ryan: Nice. Minor wording nit: avoid saying "bug". Use "observed first-token latency" and "recommended mitigation".

amanda: Good point. Also adding a short troubleshooting checklist: 1) try prefetch=false; 2) microbatch 5-20ms; 3) re-run smoke and compare throughput.

vikram: Add a note about tokenizer variance causing apparent short-prefix bursts (link to tokenization note).

amanda: Added. Will merge after one ML + one Docs approval. Planning to backport a single-line note to the main migration checklist after merge.

ryan: If you want me to, I can add the JS snippet as a runnable example in `examples/js/optimize/prefetch`.

amanda: That would be great, thanks. I'll ping when the branch is ready for review.

docbot: CI queued: examples-smoke (expected ~7m).

amanda: Thanks all  will post a summary in #eng-ml after merge with artifact links.
